newsitem.title: DENMARK: Maersk & C&W in data deal.
newsitem.headline: Maersk & C&W in data deal.

text.p: Danish shipping and oil group A.P. Moeller's Maersk Data unit said on Friday it would participate with Britain's Cable and Wireless Plc in a global IT-communications for container ships joint venture.
It said a new jointly-owned company called Cable & Wireless Nautec would be launched in July provided the necessary European Union approval was granted.
"The new company will combine Maersk Data's success in developing IT systems for shipping with Cable & Wireless' global network expertise," Maersk said in a statement.
"Cable & Wireless Nautec will provide global IT and communications systems and advanced IT and network services to customers in container transport," it said.
"C&W is a worldwide company and it is very strong in the Far East. That is where we see growth coming," Maersk said.
It said it expected the joint venture to secure a 25 percent share of the world market for communications and information technology within the shipping industry in the first year of operation.
